full_text_tesim: According to the sequence of the text, it is possible to assume that the bifolios 24-25 and 22-27 belonged to the same quire
Informal minuscule, upright or sloping to the right, with numerous abbreviations. The liturgical rubrics are written in a small “Alexandrinische Auszeichnungs-Majuskel”
